days.label: Day 1
days.title: Arrive and settle in
days.text: Pickup from NJP or Bagdogra and a scenic climb to Darjeeling. Evening stroll along Mall Road and Chowrasta.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Sunrise and tea country
days.text: Pre-dawn drive to Tiger Hill for the Kanchenjunga sunrise (weather permitting), then Batasia Loop and Ghum Monastery. Afternoon at a working tea estate.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Toy train and heritage
days.text: Morning joyride on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, then the zoo and the mountaineering institute. Evening free for cafes.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Departure
days.text: A slow breakfast with a view, then a comfortable drop to NJP or Bagdogra.
